statement: Prove by induction that $\sum_{k=1}^{n}k^{3}=\left(\dfrac{n(n+1)}{2}\right)^{2}$ for all positive integers $n$.
solution: Base case $n=1$: $1^{3}=1=(\tfrac{1\cdot2}{2})^{2}$, true. Assume true for $n$. Then $\sum_{k=1}^{n+1}k^{3}=\left(\tfrac{n(n+1)}{2}\right)^{2}+(n+1)^{3} =(n+1)^{2}\left(\tfrac{n^{2}}{4}+n+1\right)=(n+1)^{2}\tfrac{n^{2}+4n+4}{4} =\left(\tfrac{(n+1)(n+2)}{2}\right)^{2}$, completing the induction.
hints: Assume for $n$ and add $(n+1)^{3}$, then factor.
